CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.flag_import_seller_edit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE public.fb_marketplace_import_items i SET seller_edited=true
 FROM public.asks a WHERE i.listing_id=a.id AND a.seller_id=auth.uid()
 AND ((TG_TABLE_NAME='asks' AND a.id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'id')::uuid) OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='products' AND a.product_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'id')::uuid) OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='classified_listing_details' AND a.id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'listing_id')::uuid));
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_trusted_operation()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(current_setting('parkvault.trusted_operation', true) = 'on', false)
      -- Maintenance/administrative connections. These are NEVER treated as a
      -- marketplace member: member functions still require auth.uid().
      OR current_user IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role');
$function$
